behavior: A check names every features.json whose shape differs from the scaffold: a top-level non-array, an empty array, a non-object element, a missing, extra or renamed key, a non-string value, invalid JSON.
The check reports every differing file and no conforming one, and a conforming tree (any key order, CRLF, a passing state with evidence) exits 0.
Fixtures with a non-template object make the check fail under both bash and zsh, and a disabled check fails them.
The check never rewrites a reported file, archived specs included, and fails closed (exit 2) without jq or on a missing directory.
The check runs to a verdict on the real tree (exit 0 or 1, never 2); the PR lists every spec it reports, which is a review step and not machine-checkable.
